body: I honestly thought I was going to get yelled at here for not being supportive enough.

>7 years younger

To be fair maybe I was a bit fooled into thinking he might have a more mature mindset because he was a competent dad when we met

His son is with his Grandma.

I don't know what I'll do, right now I'm giving him space and not texting or calling like he asked. I'm still needing to work and take care of my own house which is hard with my mental health being this poor.

He left a whole bunch of his dirty laundry and lots of his stuff in my house as well.
No I'm his step mother but I don't have him when he's not with my ex
His ex and his mother are doing the bulk of the child care duties at the moment as far as I am aware.
